observations: Close-up of a used car engine block with significant surface rust and dirt.
The engine is mounted on a stand in what appears to be a workshop or garage.
A metal bracket is visible on the right side of the engine.
The engine block has multiple mounting holes and a central circular opening.
A watermark 'SOMITO GREAT' is visible across the center of the image.
A timestamp '2026/10/05 11:03' is visible at the bottom left of the image.

claims.evidence: The engine block is not a Hyundai Santa Fe; it is a generic engine block.
The engine block shown is not a 4WD transfer case.
The coolant reservoir is not visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The item may not be a Hyundai Santa Fe 4WD transfer case as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine block with the Hyundai Santa Fe logo or a clear photo of the engine identification plate.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized, overheated, or have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a photo of the engine with a mechanic's inspection light.

risks.risk: The transfer case may be missing or the output shaft may be broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the transfer case and a video showing the output shaft being rotated.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine identification plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the Hyundai Santa Fe logo on the engine block.
Photo of the transfer case if it is included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
